record.content: The Inyo National Forest page describes Pine Grove as a small, quiet 10-site campground below Rock Creek. It is first-come, first-served with self-registration; limits RVs to 15 feet and stays to 14 days; provides bear boxes, potable water, and picnic tables; has no electrical hookups; and publishes coordinates 37.4706,-118.7243 and elevation 9,300 feet.
